unit.title: The lining holds the dress in shape
unit.needIt: When a dress or coat hangs well, something hidden is doing the work. Knowing that explains why cheap clothes lose their shape.
unit.why: A dressmaker wants to make a dress that looks perfect on a person with a large figure. She learns that a one-piece dress creates long lines to help the wearer feel confident. She discovers that a well-fitted lining is the secret to making the dress stay in place and look smooth.
unit.outcome: Construct a one-piece dress with a fitted lining and proper proportions.
unit.reachesYou: You see these techniques when you notice how a well-made dress hangs on a mannequin in a shop. You also feel them when your own clothes shift out of place because they lack a proper lining.
unit.do: Measure your waist and find a piece of sturdy fabric to practice making a simple waist lining.

choices: A garment cut in one piece from shoulder to hem
A dress with a separate skirt
quiz.why: The text defines a one-piece dress as a garment cut in one piece from the shoulder to the hem.
quiz.quote: When we talk about the "One-Piece Dress'' we mean a garment all cut in one piece from the shoulder to the hem at the bottom.

quiz.q: Why is a lining important for woolens?
choices: It keeps the garment in position
quiz.why: The text says the lining will keep the garment in position on the body for woolens.
quiz.quote: When this dress is made from Woolens it is much more satisfactory if the waist is lined as it will not only wear better but the lining will keep the garment in position on the body.

quiz.q: Where should hooks be sewn on the lining?
quiz.why: The instructions state that hooks must always be sewn on to the right side.
quiz.quote: Hooks must always be sewed on to the right side and eyes on the left.

quiz.q: How much longer should the belting be than the waist?
quiz.why: The text says to measure the belting one inch longer than the waist measurement.
quiz.quote: Measure the belting having it one inch longer than the waist measurement.

quiz.q: What should you do to the lining before pinning it to the belting?
quiz.why: The lining must be stretched down to fit the body snugly before pinning.
quiz.quote: The lining must be stretched down and made to fit snugly before it is pinned.

partials: Lining must be fitted very carefully
Belting must be one inch longer
crystal.key: A well-fitted lining is essential for the shape and position of a one-piece dress.

decoys.why: The text says a lining in a dress that is to be washed makes ironing more difficult.

decoys.text: Hooks and eyes are sewn on the left.
decoys.why: The text says hooks must be sewn on the right side.

crystal.aha: The lining acts as the hidden foundation that ensures the dress fits and moves correctly.
